verdict.rationale: Brex's developer portal lists a dedicated Accounting API described as letting developers 'View and manage accounting data', which matches this story directly. The evidence is only a one-line catalog entry, and the community items do not address this API, so they were set aside. Missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of the specific accounting objects and operations (read vs. write), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as described.
